name: Adeyfield Adventure Playground
description: A staffed adventure playground with slides, multi-play units, an inclusive roundabout and floodlit 3G pitch. Open term time Mon-Fri 3.30-6.30pm and school holidays Mon-Fri 9.30am-5.30pm, closed in winter; priority to children aged 8 to 16, under-8s welcome with an adult.
